en: Black‑and‑white image showing a calm river in the foreground with a flat wooden raft or barge moored at the bank. Tall trees line the riverside, reflected in the water. Behind them is a stone multi‑arch bridge carrying a railway or road. On the hill above rise two cylindrical ruined stone towers, remnants of a small castle or fortress, largely surrounded by forest. In the distance to the right are a few village buildings or a manor on another hillside. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.
